Agent Name: CorporateHistory_IPOs_MondayCom_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to verify the accuracy of the manually gathered data from the search results. Specifically, the agent incorrectly identified "Oren Stern" as a current C-suite member (CMO) and "Amit Mathrani" as a current C-suite member (CRO). In reality, Oren Stern is the CEO of Monday.com (not a C-suite executive in the context of the company's leadership structure at the time of the IPO, as he was not part of the founding C-suite), and Amit Mathrani is the CEO of a different company (or a different role entirely, not a CRO at Monday.com). The agent's error stemmed from misinterpreting the search snippets or hallucinating the roles of these individuals, leading to an incorrect final list that excluded the actual founders (Shiran Nawi, Yoni Osherov, Daniel Lereya) who were part of the C-suite at the IPO but are not currently in the C-suite, or conversely, included people who were never C-suite members. The correct answer involves Shiran Nawi, Yoni Osherov, and Daniel Lereya, who were co-founders and held C-suite positions at the IPO but have since left or changed roles, whereas the agent's list included incorrect names.
